description: Transports en commun Pays des Ecrins is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Pays des Écrins. The Community Council of 1 August 2024 unanimously decided to create regular public transport lines open to all and operating throughout the year without seasonal fluctuations. For more information on public transport in the Pays des Ecrins: Regular transport 2025 Schedules and Stops School transport timetables. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Pays des Écrins. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport Pays des Ecrins" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Pays des Écrins. Its keywords include bus, reseau-de-transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GTFS, GTFS-RT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
